time_grid_audit.explanation: Each scenario simulates 15 elapsed minutes (intervals [0,1] through [14,15]). The 16 point samples represent endpoint temperatures. The previous figure of 800 was discrete sample count (50 x 16), not elapsed minutes. The actual elapsed operating time is exactly 750.0 minutes.

reconciliation_notice.sample_counts_vs_duration: The 583, 565, 544, and 479 figures represent discrete violating sample counts (out of 800 total point samples). Continuous interpolated excursion duration across the 750 elapsed minutes is 543.25 min (Method A), 525.52 min (Method B), 503.50 min (Method D), and 449.14 min (Method C). Method C saves 94.12 minutes (-17.32%) against reactive control and 54.37 minutes (-10.80%) against unguided optimization.
reconciliation_notice.feasibility_reconciliation: Strict physical trajectory feasibility is achieved in 18/50 scenarios (36.0%). 27/50 scenarios engage Emergency Fallback because initial temperature is pre-breached or ambient heat gain exceeds maximum 15-minute cooling capacity.
